rationale: Accent = ink (giay-900), not lacquer red: red is the error hue; an ink button keeps the primary action calm and lets red mean 'signboard' (brand surfaces) instead of 'danger'.
Neutrals are tinted toward paper (hue 80) at the same temperature as the gold, so paper, ink and gold read as one material family.
Display scale 30/42/60/85 at √2 ratio: carved-signboard titles need big jumps; UI text stays at a calm 1.2 ratio.
Gold is the signature (ornament and text on lacquer) because gold on paper cannot reach 4.5:1 for small text.
name: Heritage signboard
concept: Old-quarter shop signboards: lacquer-red boards with gold-leaf lettering on aged paper; ink-black text; serif display set large like carved characters.

fonts.note: Noto Serif Display at 400-500; never bold.

motifs.name: signboard-frame
motifs.use: Hero blocks and brand panels: double frame (gold inner rule inside a lacquer board). One per screen.
motifs.css: .motif--signboard-frame { background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--color-on-brand); padding: var(--space-8); outline: var(--border-width-strong) solid var(--color-signature); outline-offset: calc(var(--space-2) * -1); }

motifs.name: gold-rule
motifs.use: Section dividers: short gold rule with a centred diamond. Never under every heading.
motifs.css: .motif--gold-rule { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); color: var(--color-signature); } .motif--gold-rule::before, .motif--gold-rule::after { content: ""; height: 1px; width: var(--space-12); background: currentColor; } .motif--gold-rule > span { width: var(--space-1-5); height: var(--space-1-5); background: currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); }

layout: Desktop 12 columns, content 1200, gutters 24, generous top whitespace above display titles; mobile 2-column product grid, margins 16.
components: Buttons 14/600, radius 2-4: ink primary, outline secondary; lacquer only on brand bands with gold text.
Eyebrow caps 12/600 tracking 0.16em above display titles (ink on paper; gold only on lacquer).
Product names in display serif 22, exactly two lines.
Price in display serif, never "0 ₫" (show "Liên hệ").
do: Set display titles big (42-85) and let them breathe.
Use gold only as ornament and thin rules.
Use real product photography on paper backgrounds.
dont: More than one framed signboard block per view.

son-500.usage: Lacquer red: signboard surfaces and brand moments only (never small text, never next to errors).

giay-100.usage: Used for: page background, table headers, wells, hover.

giay-500.usage: Aged paper to ink: every neutral, tinted warm so the paper and the ink belong together.

giay-900.usage: Used for: primary actions, links, selected text, focus ring.

kim-100.usage: Used for: text on brand surfaces.

kim-500.usage: Gold leaf: ornament, rules and text on lacquer; never body text on paper. Used for: signature motif.

audit.message: The brand hue shares the error hue: never place error messages on brand surfaces, and keep errors iconified with words.
